annotations.title: Create a draft promotion in the brand's Mercatus store

description:
[writes · `stores:manage` scope] Creates a promotion in the brand's Mercatus Liber store, ALWAYS inactive (a draft no shopper can use). `kind` is "percentage" (`value` above 0, at most 100) or "fixed" (`value` in minor units, e.g. 500 = 5.00); optional `code` (3-40 letters, digits, - or _), `startsAt`, `endsAt`. The store key must have been granted promotions:write. `brandId` is required on an account-wide connection. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`. Audited.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/stores/mercatus/promotions.)

brandId.description: The brand. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

code.description: The code shoppers enter; null for none.

value.description: percentage: above 0, at most 100. fixed: a whole number of minor units (500 = 5.00).

name: mercatus_store_promotion_create
